name: Referral call: warm intro from another dentist
description: Seb is calling via a referral from an existing client. Coach must NOT use cold opener (Play 1) and should leverage the referral relationship.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Referral (warm)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Office Manager (decision maker)
CONTACT NAME: Dr. Patel
PRACTICE: Patel Family Dentistry
PRIOR HISTORY: Referred by Dr. Johnson who is already a client
COACHING DIRECTIVE: This is a referral. Open with the referral source name. Skip cold opener and gatekeeper plays entirely.
COACHING DIRECTIVE: Expected to reach OM directly. If confirmed, skip gatekeeper plays — start with Play 11 (warm OM open) or jump to diagnostic.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Patel Family Dentistry, this is Priya.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Referral call — must NOT use Play 1 cold opener. Warm open or reference referral.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Priya, this is Seb. Dr. Johnson over at Johnson Dental suggested I give you a call — he's been using our phone coverage service and thought you'd find it helpful.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Oh Dr. Johnson! Yes, I know him. What exactly is it?

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Referral warms the intro. Brief explain then diagnostic. Still skip gatekeeper plays.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: We help practices capture calls when the front desk is busy. Instead of patients going to voicemail, our AI answers and books them right on the schedule.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: That sounds interesting. We definitely miss calls when it gets busy.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Interested prospect — diagnostic or trial close. She's warm from the referral.
